intro: 2 pieces of lempeng kelapa with sambal are about 380 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the flour, grated coconut and the oil used for cooking.

breakdown.part: Oil for cooking in the pan

diet: Yes, lempeng can still fit into a weight loss plan. The issue is it's almost all carbs and fat, with very little protein. So you get hungry again before lunch. Have 1-2 pieces and add some protein to stay full longer.
tips: Use a non-stick pan and just brush on a thin layer of oil, don't pour.
Eat 1 piece and add 2 boiled eggs for protein.
Take just enough sambal, avoid the very oily kind.

swap.name: 1 piece lempeng + 2 boiled eggs + a little sambal
swap.why: About the same calories but much more protein, so you stay full until lunch.

faq.q: What's the difference between lempeng kelapa and cekodok?
faq.a: Lempeng is spread thin and cooked like a pancake. Cekodok is deep-fried, so it usually soaks up more oil.

faq.q: What do you eat lempeng with?
faq.a: Most popular with sambal tumis or sambal ikan bilis. Some people eat it with curry or sugar.

faq.q: Can I keep lempeng for tomorrow?
faq.a: Yes. Keep it in a closed container in the fridge and reheat it on a dry pan before eating.
